question: In plants, resins and gums are stored especially in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**old xylem**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Old Xylem:**

 
 
• In plants, resins and gums are often stored in the old (or secondary) xylem.
 
• Xylem tissue is responsible for transporting water and dissolved minerals upwards from the roots to the rest of the plant.
 
• As a plant grows, new xylem is formed, and the older xylem towards the center of the stem or root becomes non-functional for water transport.
 
• This older, non-conducting xylem is called heartwood.
 
• Heartwood is often the site of accumulation of various substances, including resins, gums, tannins, and other extractives.
